kultivator.gui43.m18.gerak: Motion warning: Spectacular Camera uses fast sweeps, crash zooms, rolls and slowed time. If fast motion makes you dizzy, cancel and stay on Full.
kultivator.gui43.m18.dampak: Photosensitivity warning: Full impact frames use full-screen flashes and colour inversion. Do not enable them if you are sensitive to flashing light.
kultivator.gui43.m18.hardcore.nyala: Turn on Hardcore Breakthroughs? A failed breakthrough will drop you a whole realm.
kultivator.gui43.m18.hardcore.mati: Turn off Hardcore Breakthroughs? A failed breakthrough will only cause Qi Deviation again.
kultivator.gui43.m18.hardcore.how: Turning it on needs the seal held for 1.5 seconds.
kultivator.gui43.m18.keys.petunjuk: Click a row to change its key; right-click restores the default.
kultivator.gui43.m18.clash_note: Red keys are also used by another key (its name is written next to it). Click the row to change it.
kultivator.gui43.m18.key.ubah: Click: change key · right-click: back to default
kultivator.gui43.m18.key.tangkap: Press the new key for %s. Esc cancels, Backspace unbinds.
kultivator.gui43.m18.vanilla.tip: Opens the Minecraft Controls screen for the game's own keys. Done or Esc returns here.
